text:
incident-bot: PAGER — P0: High 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2. 5xx ~12% over the last 3m. Pager routed to oncall: @alice.m. Runbook: triage autoscaling, model cache, and recent deploys.

alice.m: ack — I'm on it, starting triage. Sam, can you join?

sam.ops: joining. pulling monitoring graphs now.

sam.ops: looking at metrics — spike source looks like gen-worker queue increasing latencies, autoscaler didn't add nodes. kubernetes events show repeated OOMKilled on pod prod-gen-7.

ira.eng: jumping in. There's a recent image roll (prod/gen:20260202) deployed 09:06 UTC. Kernel logs on the node show repeated "OOMKilled" and lots of memory growth in tokenizer cache. Trying quick revert to previous image on a single canary.

sam.ops: canary revert initiated on us-west-2a (replica set scaled to previous image). Rolling back only one AZ to validate.

alice.m: quick decision: prepare a statuspage initial notice. Draft below — please review quickly, we need to publish within the next 10min if the revert doesn't help.

commie: draft statuspage copy (initial):
"We are investigating increased error rates (5xx) impacting the Generation endpoint (/v1/generate) in the US-West region. Some requests are failing with 5xx errors. Our on-call team is actively triaging and has initiated a rollback of a recent service deployment. We will provide updates every 15 minutes or as we have more information. No evidence of customer data loss at this time."

ira.eng: small wording change request: replace "No evidence of customer data loss" -> "No evidence of customer data loss has been found" (so it's present-tense and cautious).

legal-bot: noted. wording acceptable.

commie: approved with ira edit. ready to publish when we confirm either improvement or broader rollback.

sam.ops: canary rollback looks good — error rate on that AZ dropped from 14% -> 0.8% within 3 minutes. Monitoring the rest.

alice.m: publishing initial statuspage update now to be transparent.

statuspage-bot: Published incident on statuspage: INCIDENT-20260202-USW-GEN-1 — https://status.redwood.example/INCIDENT-20260202-USW-GEN-1 :rotating_light:

alice.m: also drafting targeted customer email to customers with >100k monthly tokens. Draft: 
Subject: "Temporary error increase for Generation API in US-West — we're on it"
Body: "Hi — our systems detected increased 5xx errors for the Generation API in US-West. We are rolling back a recent deploy and expect service to be restored shortly. No evidence of data loss. We will send updates as the situation evolves. — Redwood Inference Ops"

commie: tweak subject to "Service degradation for Generation API in US-West — update" then send.

alice.m: sent targeted email to affected customers (support ticket + outbound).

20m_update — sam.ops: broad rollback completed across all AZs; error rate globally down to 0.3% and trending down. Throughput looks stable.

ira.eng: preliminary root cause: memory leak introduced in tokenizer cache path in prod/gen:20260202 causing OOMs and restarts under sustained load. Fix PR in review to add memory caps and incremental flush.

sam.ops: will keep autoscaler thresholds conservative until patch lands.

alice.m: posting second status update: we have rolled back the recent image in US-West; errors are falling and throughput is normalizing. Engineers continue root cause analysis and will follow up with a post-incident report. Next update in 30 minutes or on resolution.

statuspage-bot: Status update published to incident INCIDENT-20260202-USW-GEN-1 (update #2).

2h40m_update — ira.eng: hotfix merged and promoted to staging; automated tests passing. Patch includes tokenizer cache memory guard, and improved liveness probe tolerances. Scheduling production rollout after quick smoke.

alice.m: performing smoke rollout now in canary -> monitoring.

sam.ops: canary looks healthy. rolling to remaining AZs with 10% stride.

alice.m: resolved — errors have returned to baseline (<0.1%), memory usage stable, and no further OOMs seen after hotfix rollout.

statuspage-bot: Resolved notice published for INCIDENT-20260202-USW-GEN-1. Resolution summary: issue caused by a memory regression in tokenizer cache in a recent deployment; rollback + hotfix restored normal service. :white_check_mark:

alice.m: great work team — please add root cause and timeline to the postmortem doc (link in #incidents-postmortems). We'll run RCA and roll out additional safeguards (automatic memory caps and a pre-deploy perf test) to prevent recurrence.

commie: I'll draft a customer-facing post-incident summary once the RCA is finalized.

legal-bot: confirm no regulatory impact flagged; closing monitoring task.

incident-bot: Pager cleared for INCIDENT-20260202-USW-GEN-1.

alice.m: thanks everyone — reopening if anything regresses.
